description: This file is a Java class implementing the ProductOptionService interface. It provides methods to manage ProductOption entities, including listing, retrieving by name or code, saving, updating, and deleting options. It interacts with DAO and other services related to product attributes and store-specific options.

classes.name: ProductOptionServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ProductOptionService interface, managing ProductOption entities with CRUD operations, list retrieval, and dependency interactions.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product options associated with a specific merchant store in a certain language.

methods.name: listReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves a read-only list of product options for a given store and language.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Fetches product options matching a specific name within a store and language context.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new or updates an existing ProductOption entity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a ProductOption and its associated ProductAttributes from the store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOption based on its code within a store.
